name: Haemoglobin
description: Haemoglobin is the protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen from your lungs to the rest of your body.
reasonsHigh: Not drinking enough fluids before the test
reasonsLow: Low iron, vitamin B12 or folate
Recent blood loss, including heavy periods
Pregnancy, which naturally dilutes the blood
questions: What might explain this haemoglobin result for me?
Would it help to check iron, B12 or folate?
